Thin years deepened: 2026 now has 5 distinct sources (AFCAT 1 held 31 Jan 2026, AFCAT 2 held 8 Aug 2026 in 2 shifts; incl. a direct Prepp CDN PDF of the Shift 2 paper) and 2021 now has 4 distinct sources (AFCAT 1 20–22 Feb 2021, AFCAT 2 28–30 Aug 2021, shift-wise; incl. a direct Prepp CDN PDF of the 22 Feb 2021 Shift 1 paper). All 9 URLs returned HTTP 200 via curl on 2026-11-21. Duplicates skipped: Prepp practice-papers hub (round 2) and Testbook/Adda247 hubs (round 1) already cover 2021–2026 at hub level. No YouTube videos added (round 1 already has 4).
